description: WH-1 / UC-1 / KIR-2: a unit's per-turn charge flags (charged_this_turn, fights_first, ...) must end with its own turn. Fixture ork11e_orks_active (P1 Orks, War Horde). Setup privileges: auto wound allocation on; Custodian Guard E is moved to (40", 52") and cut to 3 models (not below half strength), the Battlewagon is put ~2" from it; both players' CP are set to 0 (no Command Re-roll / Overwatch interludes); the charge dice are seeded; P1's own Fight phase is skipped with transition_to_phase (its fights are not under test and both units must survive into P2's turn). Real clicks: the Battlewagon charges Custodian Guard E through the charge panel (Declare, Roll, Snap to contact, Confirm) — it fights first in P1's Fight phase; P1's turn is then ended through the Scoring phase's End Turn button + End Turn Without Discarding. In P2's turn (Command, Movement, Shooting, Charge ended through the phase button and its confirm, Heroic Intervention declined) the Battlewagon's charge flags are gone: the Fight phase starts in the remaining-combats step with P2 picking first (no stale fights-first). P2 fights with Custodian Guard E (Ka'tah stance, All to Target, Fight!, P1's ORKS IS NEVER BEATEN declined), then P1 selects the Battlewagon: the unit_selected_to_fight window offers HIT 'EM HARDER but NOT MOW 'EM DOWN (it did not charge THIS turn).
